permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.
Explore uses webPrincipal plus authenticated ownerId; knowledge/graph service filters authorized current source evidence. Export is limited to current visible result.
Graph rejects share principals. Graph control/state/command management requires principal.id=web-owner; evidence/explore scope follows sourceAccess authorization (analysis-source.ts:31).

sourceContracts.designReason: Existing user-visible surface requires baseline-aligned hierarchy, controls, feedback and responsive treatment without adding behavior.
notes: Source inventory only; no runtime behavior asserted.

hostContracts.scope: Complete owner shell only in complete main-page assets; this child uses actual parent metadata and a neutral local crop.

compositionRules.hostRendering: Complete authoritative owner/standalone host for full pages. Other surfaces use actual local component on a neutral background or only a small truthful parent cue; do not repeat full rail/sidebar/header. Large windows retain real title/close/body scrolling/footer.
compositionRules.incompatibleStates: Never combine mutually exclusive conditions into one apparent app screen; compact rows/sections are independent specimens.
compositionRules.captions: Source/title/role/state are recorded here as metadata; optional external labels never become product UI. Missing outer caption alone is not a functional failure.
compositionRules.legibility: Every field/action/row must remain readable at reference scale. Increase artifact canvas or split this job if necessary; never shrink or delete content to meet a job count.

originalManifest.geometryFamily: exact source renderer and field/action layout: WS-085
originalManifest.generationInstruction: Read generation-execution-contract.md. Use actual template/role and selected baseline visible state before generic plan text. Submit a concise exact prompt for this one asset; full source/state/field/action contracts remain in this manifest and original plan. Draw independent labeled matrix rows/panels as specified, not incompatible states in one product page. Local component designs do not redraw full host. Full pages use their actual role-specific shell. Source-derived states are examples, not runtime acceptance. No invented features/inputs/buttons/permissions or fake saved/connected outcomes. Keep every existing visible action and actual disabled guard. Save full actual submittedPrompt and input responsibilities in SHA-bound sidecar, pending independent review.

submittedPrompt: 制作中文知识图谱手机完整画布页A/B两个独立视口，A390、B320窄屏比例，正常文字图标，不画手机壳/系统栏或尺寸数字。参考真实手机图谱的节点/边分布与内容，不发明新实体关系。统一白底浅灰边线蓝色选中。完整真实应用宿主：顶部返回箭头、“知识图谱”、小字“应用工作空间”；页面标题行“返回”“知识图谱”，右侧小绿点“基础分析就绪”。工具栏自然换行且完全在视口内：搜索框placeholder“搜索概念、实体或笔记”、清除/搜索图标；“知识”（选中）/“笔记”分段，筛选齿轮按钮；“画布”（选中）/“列表”分段；宿主模式不加更多图谱操作菜单和审核按钮。摘要“33 个节点”“109 条关系”，刷新图标“刷新”。下面主要区域是大白色画布细边框，复用参考中的隔离图谱现有圆节点与细连线集群，绿色概念、灰蓝笔记，保持一个清楚的图谱不是装饰插画，节点文字可简短“知识”“行动”“资料”“界面”。画布内底部固定可达工具“＋”“−”“适应画布”，和小型图例“笔记”“概念”“人物”“组织”“地点”“事件”“技术”，说明“虚线表示候选或相似线索”，正常折行不超宽。页面底部真实应用导航“知识图谱”（选中）“笔记图谱”“关系审核”“后台分析”“更多”。A/B保留同一owner画布状态；不打开详情侧栏、模型窗、错误或假分析成功提示，不添加AI聊天/团队功能。
